newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 507,900 MT were double the week earlier, but 29 percent below the 4-week average. Major increases for Japan (94,900 MT, which had 110,200 MT in new sales and 15,300 MT in cancellations), South Korea (76,800, including 28,600 MT in new sales and 48,200 MT in destination changes), Poland (69,400, including 51,400 MT in new sales and 18,000 MT in destination changes), Egypt (67,300 MT, which reflects 67,000 MT in destination changes), Tunisia (64,400 MT), and Singapore (60,500 MT) were partially offset by decreases reported for unknown destinations (83,200 MT), Malaysia (53,000 MT), and Jordan (50,000 MT).

Exports of 1,282,800 MT were 1 percent less than the prior week, but 4 percent more than the 4-week average. Japan (286,000 MT), Taiwan (187,300 MT), South Korea (156,800 MT), Mexico (120,600 MT), Egypt (67,300 MT), Colombia (60,700 MT), and Singapore (60,500 MT) were the primary recipients.
